query: Key contributions and follow-ups of 'Attention Is All You Need' (2017)
highlights: The paper introduces scaled dot-product attention mechanism [1, p.4, Fig.2].
Multi-head attention involves multiple attention layers running in parallel [1, p.4, Fig.2].
Transformer architecture achieves better BLEU scores compared to previous models on English-to-German and English-to-French translations [1, p.8].
Table 3 shows variations of the Transformer architecture with performance metrics [1, p.9].
